text:
Aisha: Quick ask — we have three customers asking for EMEA-friendly office hours next week (Copenhagen, London, Munich). Current recurring slot is 10:30 CEST which is a bit late for DK/UK folks. Can we move it earlier or rotate times?

Tom: Yep saw the requests. What's the minimum lead time to push the recurring event?

Marcel: If we move the slot we should keep it consistent for the next 4 weeks so customers see a stable cadence. I can cover timezone conversions for invites.

Aisha: Thinking out loud — options: Thu 09:00 CEST (preferred by London), Thu 08:00 CEST (better for Copenhagen), or Tue 10:00 CEST (keeps current weekday but earlier). Poll below?

Tom: Poll sounds good. Trainer rotation note: Lukas is available Thu mornings, I'm only Tue/Thu after 09:30.

Aisha: Poll options:
```
A: Thu 09:00 CEST
B: Thu 08:00 CEST
C: Tue 10:00 CEST
```

Sofia (Acct Lead - NovaHealth): Our PM prefers B (Thu 08:00) — earlier is easier to get the whole team on.

Lukas (Trainer): B works for me. I can present the 20-min workshop on best-practice prompt templates and then 10m Q&A.

Marcel: Agree B. If we pick B I'll schedule rotating trainers: Lukas week 1, Tom week 2, Marcel week 3, repeat. Keeps enablement varied.

Aisha: Good plan. Agenda for the 30m slot: 5m quick check-in, 15m focused demo (customer-specific), 10m Q&A + action items. I'll make a short template we can reuse. Link to draft agenda: https://redwood-internal.docs/cs/emea-office-hours-template (internal)

Tom: One ask — can we record and auto-post the recording + transcript to the customer workspace? saves repeat questions.

calendar-bot: Created tentative event "Redwood CS — EMEA Office Hours" Thu 08:00 CEST • 30m • Recurring weekly. Invitees: NovaHealth, LumaMed, HelixWare.

Aisha: I'll follow up with customers to confirm availability. Action items: (1) Lukas / Tom / Marcel — confirm trainer rotation schedule in this thread, (2) Tom — enable auto-recording & transcript, (3) Aisha — update invites and attach agenda template.

Lukas (Trainer): Confirmed — I'll take the first session and upload slides to the shared drive. :thumbsup:

Tom: I'll flip the recording setting today. :white_check_mark:

Marcel: Scheduled on my side. If any customer asks for a different timezone we'll offer a 1:1 deep dive.

calendar-bot: Updated event time to Thu 08:00 CEST and sent updated invites.

Aisha: Thanks team — will post a quick CS note to the customers and confirm in the thread when they ack.

Sofia (Acct Lead - NovaHealth): Thanks — confirmed for my PM. See you all Thu. :raised_hands:
